description: This plot illustrates the validation performance, measured in BPC, of two models over a series of training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Steps" with a partially visible multiplier "(x10...)" at the far right, utilizing a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 50 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The y-axis is labeled "BPC" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1.2 to 2.2, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The "SMoE Validating" data is represented by a solid black line with cross markers. It begins at a high value of approximately 2.2 at 0 training steps, declines sharply to roughly 1.42 at 10 steps, remains relatively steady with a minor dip near 20 steps, and then gradually increases to end at approximately 1.65 at 50 steps. The "SimSMoE Validating" data is represented by a solid magenta line with dot markers. It starts at approximately 2.2 at 0 steps, drops sharply to roughly 1.38 at 10 steps, remains steady with a minor dip near 20 steps, and then gradually rises to finish at approximately 1.6 at 50 steps.
